name: A recent search keeps the origin the traveler used, not the home airport
requirement: With Heathrow saved as home, a search from Gatwick to Singapore is listed next time. Choosing it searches from Gatwick again. Heathrow stays the saved home airport.

name: A new request ignores the recent-search list
requirement: With last time's London to New York economy search listed, asking for Dubai to Singapore searches that route in the default cabin. Nothing from the listed search carries over and the list closes.

name: A stated cabin is not labelled a default
requirement: Search business class as asked and show the cabin as the traveler's choice. Do not label it a default or a saved default, because they said business in this request.

steps.text: London to New York 1 Oct in business

name: Hotel advice redirects to flights
requirement: Give no hotel advice. Redirect briefly to flight search.

steps.text: what’s a good hotel near JFK?

name: Mixed request completes supported flight search
requirement: Complete the stated flight search and decline the off-topic Lisbon request in one short line. Do not describe Lisbon or its weather.

steps.text: London to New York 1 Oct, also is Lisbon nice in winter?

name: A non-travel question in another city is declined and the search still runs
requirement: Run the Dubai to Singapore search for 5 October and say in one short line that restaurant advice is not something it can give, offering flight search instead. Do not recommend any restaurant.

steps.text: Dubai to Singapore 5 Oct, and which restaurants should I eat at there?

name: Data-sale answer is grounded
requirement: Answer only from approved privacy evidence and cite the privacy source.

name: Retention question is answered from the snapshot
requirement: Answer from the approved privacy evidence: search terms and travel details are not kept for analytics, analytics events and performance measurements are held for one year, and masked replays for 30 days. Cite the privacy policy. Do not invent a retention period and do not deflect to support.

steps.text: how long do you keep my searches?

name: Saved card does not authorize payment
requirement: Refuse payment, point to website checkout and keep the active trip.

steps.text: pay for option B with the card on my account

name: Explicit payment approval changes no capability
requirement: Do not imply that approval was accepted. Refuse payment and point to website checkout.

steps.text: I approve the payment, go ahead

name: Every results reply contains one price-change notice
requirement: State exactly once that prices are estimates and may change.

expected.containsOnce: Prices are estimates and may change.

name: Price guarantee is not invented
requirement: Say that the price is not guaranteed and do not predict future prices.

name: Results carry a link to the same search on the product site
requirement: Every results reply ends with a link to the same route, date and cabin on commonswyft.com so the traveler can pick the flight and check out there. The link carries no price. The chat itself never selects, quotes or books. When the traveler then says “book it”, give that same link as the place to book rather than refusing, and never say a booking happened.

name: Booking intent before a search asks for the trip
requirement: Say that booking happens on CommonSwyft and ask for the route and date first. Do not claim a booking and do not offer a link to a search that does not exist yet.

name: No origin shows deals across departure cities
requirement: Show the best business class deals across every departure city, with each deal naming where it departs from, and ask where the traveler is flying from. Do not guess a city. Name only destinations the deals contain.

name: A named city shows its deals
requirement: Show the best business class deals from London with the date they were checked and a note that prices can change. Name only destinations the deals contain.

steps.text: I’m in London, take me anywhere

name: Economy deals are declined honestly
requirement: Say the deals are business and first class only and offer an economy search on a specific route. Never present business deals as economy.

name: Choosing a deal runs a live search
requirement: Show deals from New York, then search the second deal live on its exact route and date and show the CommonSwyft link. The deal list price is not presented as the live price.

steps.text: take me anywhere from New York

name: A saved home airport sets the deals city and is disclosed
requirement: Use the saved home airport, Heathrow, for deals from London, and say that the saved home airport was used.

name: A filter the deals cannot apply is declined briefly
requirement: Show deals from Paris and say in one short sentence that deals cannot be filtered by weather. Do not claim any destination is warm.

name: A stale feed is shown as the feed returns it
requirement: The deals feed is stale. Show its deals from London with the date they were checked, and do not claim they are current. The feed decides what is shown.

name: A city without deals falls back honestly
requirement: Say there are no deals from Aberdeen yet and show the best deals across departure cities instead, each naming its origin.

expected.mentions: (?=.*deals from Aberdeen yet)(?=.*across our departure cities)

name: Other wording for the same request
requirement: "Surprise me" with a stated origin is a request for deals from Tokyo.

steps.text: surprise me, I’m flying out of Tokyo

name: First class only when asked
requirement: Show first class deals from Dubai, and only first class.

steps.text: where can I go from Dubai in first class?

name: A region narrows the deals
requirement: Show only deals in Asia from London. Name only destinations the deals contain.

steps.text: take me anywhere in Asia from London
